notes.title: 2024 QoL Patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. The freeware vr mega hit Cactus Cowboy - Plants At War just received a QoL update on all platforms.
With this update, I've been trying to lower the friction for new vr players to get into this series. Plants At War is not exactly the easiest VR shooter out there but due to its low price tag of $0 
lots of vr players might ruin their first experience with due to it.
Since I finally figured out how the math behind a virtual gunstock works, there is no reason not bringing this and some Desert Warfare features back to Plants At War!

Without much further talk here are the patch notes:


Add: Crouch button + better seated mode
Add: Virtual Gunstock option (default enabled)
Add: Walk sounds
Add: Desert Warfare posters in Intro room
Fix: Movement felt choppy at times causing motion sickness
Fix: Players could easily glitch through walls
Fix: Lev00 - C-Day: Music restarted on grabbing the start weapons
Fix: Lev00 - C-Day: Lesser Enemies spawning
Fix: Lev00 - C-Day: Flak Cannon only requires one mortar shell
Fix: Lev01 more startup ammo for M1 gun
Fix: Lev10 - Sniper part made easier by spawning less aggressive enemies
Fix: Lev 14+15 car ride now beatable in hard mode

PCVR
Fix: Now compatible with Virtual Desktops VDXR runtime

If you enjoyed Plants At War, you might want to take a peek at the all new Cactus Cowboy - Desert Warfare. 
Future Outlook on the game series: A new Cactus Cowboy game is planned.


Regards


Cactus 🌵
